walkthrough: Goal: V大's whole-picture key shift of weeks 7 and 8, one picture a week: a long colour copy of a whole picture shifted toward two tendencies at once, its lights toward a warm and its shadows toward a cool about opposite, its local colours still told apart, its values kept. A project beside the lessons, as a colour copy is: no result, no lesson, no dot; my eye judges it against the picture.

Entry: the shapes pack imported; All units, Unit 7 (Curves and coloured light): under the unit's tiles the big homework's card, a warm swatch beside a cool one, Big homework over Cold-warm copy, and New…; under it the drawing from life's card as from unit 2. Unit 8 (Form and composing) shows the same card. New… on the homework's card opens the practice options on New copy's picker with Cold-warm copy chosen beside Colour copy, the tiers, My pictures and Drawing from life as tabs.

Begin: Medium, Test vase. A sheet of one pair of the picture's shape at a colour copy's size, the sheet a little wider on the right: beside my empty frame two swatches, Lights, an orange, over Shadows, a blue (the first copy's pair; the next copy's turns to another warm and its opposite). The How shows by itself once, no demonstration: copy as if the light had changed, lights toward the warm beside the frame and shadows toward the cool; move hue and chroma, not value (greyish areas travel far and gain colour, a strong colour facing a tendency moves a little and greys, the lightest barely change); the picture's colours still read apart; big colours first, quickly, with Hard Paint. Got it: the full interface, Hard Paint, no tools of the copy's own.
Paint: the eyedropper on the Shadows swatch picks it whole; strokes down the vase. The eyedropper on Lights; strokes across the top of the background.

Compare: the picture lies over my copy at the slider's strength (Original shown, half); the card is its name, Grey and the slider: no Accurate, Almost or Again. Grey: both frames in grey, the picture in grey laid over my copy in grey: the vase's value is kept, the background's top painted lighter than the picture's. Grey again: colour. The eyedropper on the vase in my copy: the hue and chroma disc, the picture's green there a small ring, my blue a dot with an arrow to it, the two tendencies as discs (my dot on the shadows' own), and the lightness bar, 49 against 50.

After: Home, Practice options: Cold-warm copy 1 listed among the colour copies with its picture; its options button opens, renames or removes it as a colour copy's does. No lesson, dot or redo counts it; the path is as it was.
Cancel and reopen: Home at any time; the options' row reopens it as I left it, its How told once. Undo reaches only my strokes.
Chinese: s154-cold-warm-copy-zh runs this walk-through on a Chinese tablet: 大作业, 冷暖变调临摹, 色彩临摹 beside it in the picker, the swatches 亮部 and 暗部, the How in V大's terms.
